About this species: Zygophyllum arabicum is a low desert subshrub adapted to hot, dry environments. It grows in open sandy or gravelly habitats and is part of the characteristic vegetation of Saharo-Arabian deserts. Its small leaves and compact habit help reduce water loss and support survival under drought. The species should be treated carefully in taxonomic work because some databases link it with older or alternative names, so the accepted name should always be checked before use.
